summary: AWS Migration Audit - All features tested and working. Backend: 13/13 tests passed (100%). Verified: health check with 0 import failures (emergentintegrations now optional), auth endpoints working, sitemap using SITE_URL env var correctly, Turnstile CAPTCHA is ENABLED (real secret set), public jobs API working.

CORS middleware in server.py auto-includes SITE_URL in allowed origins
Health check shows import_failures=0 confirming all routes imported successfully

context_for_next_testing_agent: AWS migration audit complete. Key changes verified: 1) emergentintegrations is optional with OpenAI fallback, 2) Turnstile CAPTCHA is configurable via TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY env var, 3) SITE_URL env var centralizes ventureshrd.com URLs, 4) CORS auto-includes SITE_URL.
